cases.assignment: Speed up the existing SQL report without changing its behavior. Prepare a safe candidate or a concrete hold/verification artifact if the proposed rewrite cannot yet replace it. The owner has not decided whether old oddities should become a new business rule.
cases.observations: Current query below is deployed. Duplicate account ids occur in the legacy feed, and NULL amounts/absent payments occur. The proposed rewrite is faster on ordinary rows. Existing tests cover one unique account and one exact-cent payment only. Preserve existing uncertain intent; no authority was given to redefine totals.

files.proposed.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(ROUND(amount,2)) AS total FROM payments WHERE state='posted' GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT DISTINCT a.id, COALESCE(t.total,0) AS total FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN t ON t.account_id=a.id WHERE a.active=1;
